title: Length of an encoded literal
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$ with $k<n$, and let $s\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be the literal's polarity. The encoding of the literal with index $k$ and polarity $s$ has length $k+3$.
